about: SPLIT_40.md section 35 (SDK 4.0.5): two hosts for one model file. Made by tools/split40.py --write. Replay: build a decide with `init`, feed `events` in order, and compare the actions returned after event i with the entry [i, actions] of `actions` (no entry: none). `trace`, `expect` and `memory_after` are the simulator's inputs and results, for reading.

cases.name: fast_single
cases.about: A fast host: no probe, the same requests as one host

cases.name: server_bound
cases.about: STC 11-22: the first host at 256 kB/s, the second at 8 MB/s, the phone with room

cases.name: server_bound_zain
cases.about: Zain 11-22: the second host at 1.5 MB/s with a 2 s first byte

cases.name: server_bound_both_slow
cases.about: both hosts at 1 MB/s, the phone at 10 MB/s: together about twice

cases.name: phone_bound
cases.about: the phone at 1 MB/s, both hosts at 20 MB/s: one probe, no steal, the next probe held 30 min

cases.name: phone_3g
cases.about: a 3G phone at 100 kB/s, both hosts fast

cases.name: phone_bound_held
cases.about: a phone-bound verdict 10 min ago on this connection type: counted, no probe

cases.name: stall_on_a
cases.about: the first host stops at 3 s: at 2 s of silence the file goes on from its byte on the second

cases.name: stall_on_b
cases.about: the second host stalls after its status: judged slow at 10 s, a third host takes the tail

cases.name: switch_34_5
cases.about: 34.5: the first host under the floor (20 kB/s): cut at its byte, the rest from there on the next

cases.name: flapping_a
cases.about: the first host swings between 4 MB/s and 100 kB/s every 5 s: the caps hold

cases.name: corrupt_b
cases.about: the second host serves one wrong byte in its range: its ranges are refetched, the second mismatch blames it, the file starts over without it

cases.name: corrupt_a
cases.about: the first host serves one wrong byte in its range: refetched from the second, the hash passes, the first is blamed

cases.name: hedge_then_split
cases.about: 34.4: the first host silent, the second request at 1.5 s taken on cdn2 at 1.7 s; the split then uses the next host that may help

cases.name: b_ignores_range
cases.about: the second host answers 200 to the Range: dropped, the first goes on to the end

cases.name: b_slow_down
cases.about: the second host answers 429 (or a node 503 with Retry-After): held, the next host is asked

cases.name: b_unreachable
cases.about: the second host refuses the connection

cases.name: b_refusal
cases.about: the second host refuses with a stop: the call ends refused, the first host delivering or not

cases.name: only_per_byte_helper
cases.about: the only other host is billed per byte (no_helper): counted, no probe

cases.name: switch_off
cases.about: outside the share: the trigger is counted, nothing is sent

cases.name: small_file
cases.about: a 2 MiB file at 100 kB/s: never split

cases.name: winner_first
cases.about: the last server-bound winner of this process is asked before the order

cases.name: lanes
cases.about: three small files run beside the large one on the first host: the rate is the host's

cases.name: steal_waits_for_warmup
cases.about: the first host finishes its head 100 ms after the second host's status (a 6.5 s first byte), before any of its bytes are reported: the steal waits for the second host's warm-up and then leaves it alone; before 2026-11-23 its whole tail moved to the slower first host

cases.name: steal_sizing
cases.about: the second host finishes its half and takes the first one's remainder in proportion to the rates
